context_for_next_testing_agent: QR Attendance flow fully tested: 1) QR code verify endpoint validates PREFIX-QR-XXXXXXXX format and returns school info. 2) Manual attendance check-in/check-out API works with access code and auto-determines action based on 24hr logic. 3) Staff attendance today endpoint returns attendance records with optional chain filter. 4) Frontend QR Attendance page loads correctly with Scan QR tab, View All tab, camera toggle button, stats bar, and Today's Attendance list. 5) Mobile hamburger menu works correctly. 6) PWA manifest.json is accessible.
